notes: The published 1904 Moscow City Council cadastral plan (heritage report PDF page 231, illustration 13) shows the original tower base and eastern staircase. Four surviving Sheremetev Hospital wing corners register this plan to mapped WGS84 coordinates; a least-squares affine registration gives the anchor and directed long axis. Native +X follows the eastern stairs and +Z faces Sretenska to the south-southwest. This is an archival reconstruction frame, not a present-day building footprint.
